title: Reschedule and Cancellation Allowances Schedule (Repair Estimates & Appointments)
content:
The table sets, for each Repair Estimates & Appointments estimate type, how late a reschedule may be asked for, how many reschedules one booking may carry, the point inside which a cancellation counts as late, and the mobile trip fee.

| Estimate type | Reschedule cutoff (full hours before start) | Reschedules permitted per booking | Late-cancellation cutoff (hours before start) | Mobile trip fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Photo Estimate | 0 | 3 | 0 | 0.00 USD |
| Drive-In Estimate | 2 | 1 | 0 | 0.00 USD |
| Scheduled Estimate | 12 | 2 | 12 | 0.00 USD |
| Mobile Estimate | 24 | 1 | 24 | 39.00 USD |
| Blueprint Teardown Estimate | 24 | 2 | 24 | 0.00 USD |
| Structural Blueprint Estimate | 48 | 2 | 48 | 0.00 USD |

## Definitions

- **Reschedule cutoff** — the latest point, in full hours before the appointment start, at which a reschedule may be requested.
- **Reschedules permitted per booking** — the number of reschedules permitted on one booking.
- **Late-cancellation cutoff** — the hours before the appointment start inside which a cancellation counts as late; 0 means there is no late cancellation.
- **Mobile trip fee** — the trip fee charged on a customer-pay mobile visit that is cancelled inside the cancellation cutoff or missed.

## Notes on the figures

- Only the Mobile Estimate carries a trip fee (39.00 USD); every other type shows 0.00 USD.
- The Photo Estimate and the Drive-In Estimate show a 0-hour late-cancellation cutoff: neither has a late cancellation.
- Hypothetical reading: a Structural Blueprint Estimate appointment starting at 09:00 on a given day has a reschedule cutoff 48 full hours earlier, at 09:00 two days before.
